findings.title: Missing Primary Keys in Junction Tables
findings.description: Junction tables 'campagne_contacts', 'campagne_tags', 'expediteur_groupe', and 'user_contact_tags' lack primary keys, allowing potential duplicates and complicating sync.
findings.remediation_hint: Implement composite primary keys on the mapping columns (e.g., ALTER TABLE campagne_contacts ADD PRIMARY KEY (campagne_id, contact_id)).

evidence.query: SELECT t.table_name FROM information_schema.tables t LEFT JOIN information_schema.table_constraints tc ON t.table_name = tc.table_name AND tc.constraint_type = 'PRIMARY KEY' WHERE t.table_name IN ('campagne_contacts', 'campagne_tags', 'expediteur_groupe', 'user_contact_tags') AND tc.constraint_type IS NULL

findings.title: MSISDN Join Integrity Violation
findings.description: Structural mismatch and orphan records between 'contacts.msisdn' (varchar) and 'campagne_contacts.contact_id' (bigint). 17 contact IDs in campaigns do not exist in the master contact list.
findings.remediation_hint: Align data types to bigint or varchar consistently and establish a formal foreign key constraint after cleaning orphan records.

evidence.query: SELECT DISTINCT contact_id FROM campagne_contacts WHERE contact_id::text NOT IN (SELECT msisdn FROM contacts)

findings.title: SMSC Identifier Type Mismatch and Orphans
findings.description: The 'smsc.id' is integer, but 'sent_sms.smsc_id' is varchar. 2 records in 'sent_sms' contain non-numeric or non-existent SMSC identifiers.
findings.remediation_hint: Convert 'sent_sms.smsc_id' to integer and add a foreign key constraint to 'smsc(id)'.

evidence.query: SELECT DISTINCT smsc_id FROM sent_sms WHERE smsc_id !~ '^[0-9]+$' OR (smsc_id ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND smsc_id::int NOT IN (SELECT id FROM smsc))

findings.title: Suspicious Nulls in Core Business Relations
findings.description: 8 records in the 'groupe' table have NULL values for 'admin_id' or 'organization_id', which are critical for ownership and access control.
findings.remediation_hint: Enforce NOT NULL constraints on 'groupe(admin_id, organization_id)' after populating missing values.

evidence.query: SELECT count(*) FROM groupe WHERE admin_id IS NULL OR organization_id IS NULL

findings.title: Redundant Unique Constraint in prm_status
